title.zh: 柴油30和拖拉机带动4100有何不同

description.en: Diesel 30 prints an engine code, 4105 / 56 kW. The tractor page prints power 40 kW and slump 180–220 mm, with no engine code.
description.zh: 柴油30印出发动机代号 4105 / 56 kW。拖拉机页印功率 40 kW 和坍落度 180–220 mm，没有发动机代号。

h1.zh: 柴油30和拖拉机带动4100有何不同

directAnswer.en: Diesel 30 and the Tractor-Driven 4100 are concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Diesel 30 prints 4105 / 56 kW, 15 m³/h, 20 MPa and distance 60 m / 180 m. The tractor prints 40 kW, 6–12 m³/h, 15 MPa, distance 40–100 m / 15–45 m and the only slump cell in the pump tables, 180–220 mm. One distance is a single pair. The other is a range.
directAnswer.zh: 柴油30和拖拉机带动4100是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵。柴油30印 4105 / 56 kW、15 m³/h、20 MPa、距离 60 m / 180 m。拖拉机印 40 kW、6–12 m³/h、15 MPa、距离 40–100 m / 15–45 m，以及泵表里唯一的坍落度格 180–220 mm。一个距离是单组数字，另一个是范围。

heading.en: Where Diesel 30 and Tractor-Driven 4100 print different values
heading.zh: 柴油30和拖拉机带动4100哪些数值不同

body.en: Theoretical output: Diesel 30 prints 15 m³/h; Tractor-Driven 4100 prints 6–12 m³/h. Hopper capacity: Diesel 30 prints 0.3 m³; Tractor-Driven 4100 prints 0.25 m³. Max. aggregate size: Diesel 30 prints 3 cm and below; Tractor-Driven 4100 prints 1–3 cm. Dimensions: Diesel 30 prints 4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm; Tractor-Driven 4100 prints 2900 × 1000 × 1350 mm. These are printed cells on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other.
body.zh: 理论输送量：柴油30印 15 m³/h；拖拉机带动4100印 6–12 m³/h。料斗容积：柴油30印 0.3 m³；拖拉机带动4100印 0.25 m³。最大骨料粒径：柴油30印 3 cm and below；拖拉机带动4100印 1–3 cm。外形尺寸：柴油30印 4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm；拖拉机带动4100印 2900 × 1000 × 1350 mm。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上印出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。

heading.en: Cells that exist on only one of these pumps
heading.zh: 只在其中一台泵上出现的格子

body.en: Diesel 30 prints cells that Tractor-Driven 4100 does not: Diesel engine power 4105 / 56 kW; Max. outlet pressure 20 MPa; Pumping distance (H / V) 60 m / 180 m; Main unit weight 2000 kg. Tractor-Driven 4100 prints cells that Diesel 30 does not: Power 40 kW; Pumping pressure 15 MPa; Conveying distance (H / V) 40–100 m / 15–45 m; Concrete slump 180–220 mm; Total weight 1300 kg. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump.
body.zh: 柴油30有、拖拉机带动4100没有的行：柴油机功率 4105 / 56 kW；最大出口压力 20 MPa；输送距离（水平/垂直） 60 m / 180 m；整机重量 2000 kg。拖拉机带动4100有、柴油30没有的行：功率 40 kW；泵送压力 15 MPa；输送距离（水平/垂直） 40–100 m / 15–45 m；坍落度 180–220 mm；整机重量 1300 kg。缺了的标题不能用另一台混凝土泵来补。

heading.en: How to read the two pages without merging them
heading.zh: 怎样分开阅读这两个页面

body.en: The tractor power line does not say 4105, and Diesel 30 does not print slump. Open /en/products/diesel-30-concrete-pump/ for Diesel 30 and /en/products/tractor-4100-concrete-pump/ for Tractor-Driven 4100. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance. If a job needs a figure this pair does not print, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 拖拉机的功率行没有写 4105，柴油30也没有印坍落度。看柴油30请打开 /zh/products/diesel-30-concrete-pump/，看拖拉机带动4100请打开 /zh/products/tractor-4100-concrete-pump/。河北品锦机械在河北邢台制造这些混凝土泵。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。如果工况需要这对机型没有印出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

question.en: Does Diesel 30 print the same theoretical output as Tractor-Driven 4100?
question.zh: 柴油30和拖拉机带动4100的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 30 prints 15 m³/h. Tractor-Driven 4100 prints 6–12 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油30印 15 m³/h。拖拉机带动4100印 6–12 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Diesel 30 print the same hopper capacity as Tractor-Driven 4100?
question.zh: 柴油30和拖拉机带动4100的料斗容积一样吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 30 prints 0.3 m³. Tractor-Driven 4100 prints 0.25 m³. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油30印 0.3 m³。拖拉机带动4100印 0.25 m³。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Diesel 30 print the same max. aggregate size as Tractor-Driven 4100?
question.zh: 柴油30和拖拉机带动4100的最大骨料粒径一样吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 30 prints 3 cm and below. Tractor-Driven 4100 prints 1–3 cm. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油30印 3 cm and below。拖拉机带动4100印 1–3 cm。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Why is diesel engine power missing on Tractor-Driven 4100?
question.zh: 为什么拖拉机带动4100没有柴油机功率？

answer.en: The Tractor-Driven 4100 page does not print that label. Diesel 30 prints 4105 / 56 kW. Leave the missing cell blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps.
answer.zh: 拖拉机带动4100这一页没有印这个标题。柴油30印的是 4105 / 56 kW。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。
